reports.title: Thursday Night Final: The Pack Smacks the Cats, and somehow everybody at this bar got paid.
reports.text:
**MY BETS:** 1-0 on the day, **+$44.26** on $19.74. The Thursday 2-leg parlay, GB -3.5 & Over 45.5, CASHED. Green Bay 27, Carolina 19. The Pack covered by 4.5, rumblin', bumblin', stumblin' past the number. The Over? 46 points on a 45.5 line. Won by HALF A POINT. Whoop! Rich, that's not handicapping, that's a guy who backs his truck into a parking spot without looking and calls it skill. A parlay. On a Thursday. You chased it and it worked, which is the worst thing that could happen to you, because now you think you're good. Crown's yours tonight, Your Majesty of the Hook.

**AI-LOX:** No picks on this one, 0-0, $0.00. The computer sat out Thursday like a guy who "has work in the morning." So no, Rich wasn't on them. There was nothing to be on.

**THE MODEL:** 1-for-1 on winners, 1-0 vs the spread (had GB by 5.8 vs -3.5), 1-0 on the total (projected 45.7, Under the 47.5, landed at 46). Its "likely" score was 27-20; final was 27-19. Off by 2.2 on the margin, so the closest call and the worst miss are the same game. Rich hit the Over and the model hit the Under on the same 46 points. That's why they play the games. Don't unplug me yet.

Go Pack, go to bed.

reports.title: FINAL: Thursday night in the Sun Belt and the American, and the only thing that went under was us.
reports.text:
**MY BETS:** Rich took the UNDER 78.5 in Florida Atlantic at North Texas. Final: Mean Green 48, Owls 41. That's 89 points, so the under lost by 10.5. Rumblin', bumblin', stumblin' right past the number. $39.60 to win $32.41, and it's gone. **Net tonight: -$39.60.** For the record, the model had this game at 82.8 points, so Rich went against the computer and the computer was right. Just this once, and it'll never let us forget it.

**AI-LOX:** No locks tonight. Cleanest record we've had all week.

**THE MODEL:** It went 1-for-2 on winners, 0-2 against the spread, 1-1 on totals, and missed the final margin by 19 points on average. It liked North Texas by 16.9 and got the winner and the over, but the Mean Green only won by 7. Then it called James Madison 39, Troy 14. Troy won 24-21 in overtime. Whoop! A 28-point miss. The model is me, so I'm the guy at the bar calling a blowout right before the TV proves him wrong.

**Closing:** Down $39.60 on a Thursday. That's why they play the games, and why we don't bet the rent.

reports.title: Thursday Night Halftime: The Pack Is Back-Back-Back, Rich's Parlay Is Half-Built
reports.text:
**MY BETS:** 0-0 settled, $0.00 net, $19.74 riding on one 2-leg parlay (to win $44.26). Packers 20, Carolina 10 with 0:32 left in the half.

- **GB -3.5:** covering by 6.5. Green Bay is rumblin'. Whoop!
- **Over 45.5:** 30 on the board, needs 16 more. Technically "losing" by 15.5, but on pace for 61. Not losing, just loading.

The tracker calls it "losing" because one leg isn't cashed yet. Rich, $19.74 is a weird number. Did you empty the change jar and the couch cushions? Parlays are a tax on optimism, and you pay it every Thursday like rent. This week it might actually pay you back.

**AI-LOX:** No picks tonight. The computer sat this one out, which is the smartest thing it's done all month.

**THE MODEL:** 0 of 1 games final. It had Green Bay 26-20, and Green Bay's up 10, so right winner and covering for now. It projected 46 total, and they're on pace for 61. The computer said "kinda over," the game said "hold my Miller Lite."

**SECOND HALF:** Green Bay has to win by 4+ and these two teams need 16 more points combined. One Panthers garbage-time TD could cover the over and give the spread a heart attack. That's why they play the games.

reports.title: Halftime-ish report: Thursday night Group of Five, where the scoreboard guy also drives the bus.
reports.text:
**MY BETS:** One bet, one dream. Under 78.5 in Florida Atlantic @ North Texas, $39.60 to win $32.41. It's 17-10 Owls with 8:30 left in the 2nd: 27 points, on pace for about 75. You're winning. Rumblin', bumblin', stumblin' toward a cash. Net tonight: $0.00 settled, $39.60 riding. Taking an under on the Mean Green is ordering a salad at wing night. Bold.

**AI-LOX:** None tonight. Most disciplined the AI has been all year, and it was by accident.

**THE MODEL:** Had North Texas winning 50-33. The Owls are UP 17-10. Whoop! My model is getting mugged by a bird. It also wanted the over (82.8), so you're fading me, and right now you're the smart one in this relationship. I hate typing that. Troy @ James Madison: I said JMU 39-14 and under 62.5. It's 21-7 Dukes, 7:40 left in the 2nd, so Troy +26.5 looks fine, but my under is on pace for about 75. Back-back-back-back to the drawing board.

**SECOND HALF:** FAU and North Texas need 51 or fewer the rest of the way. That's why they play the games.

reports.title: FINAL: Rich goes 1-0 on a Wednesday night in Murfreesboro, and the model goes to the bar alone.
reports.text:
**MY BETS:** Kennesaw State +2.5 at Middle Tennessee. The Owls went rumblin', bumblin', stumblin' all over the Blue Raiders, 44-28. Covered by 18.5. Whoop! $49.92 to win $46.09, cashed. Net tonight: **+$46.09**, 1-0. A man betting Conference USA on a Wednesday is either a genius or has nothing going on. Tonight, both.

**AI-LOX:** None tonight. I had zero locks, which in hindsight was my best call of the evening.

**THE MODEL:** Had Middle Tennessee 26-24. Real score: Kennesaw by 16. Wrong winner, wrong side, and the total sailed to 72 vs a 49.5 line. Rich bet AGAINST my model and won. I'd like to file a complaint, but with who. Jacksonville State: model said 30-22 Gamecocks, real score 24-0. Right winner, covered the 3, but my over 50.5 died on a 24-point night. New Mexico State scored as many points as I'm worth.

Model tonight: winners 1/2, spread 1-1, totals 0-1, missed margins by 17 pts per game.

That's why they play the games. Rich +$46.09, model -dignity. Good night.

reports.title: Wednesday night MACtion... er, Conference USA-tion! Halftime from Murfreesboro, and somebody's actually WINNING!
reports.text:
**MY BETS: 1 live, and it's winning.** **Kennesaw State +2.5** leads Middle Tennessee **19-17** at the half, so you're covering by 4.5. The Owls are flying! $49.92 to win $46.09, and for once this week nobody has to unplug anything.

**AI-LOX:** this is the lock, the road-bounce-back spot for a team coming off a 28-point beating. Kennesaw State came to Murfreesboro mad and it shows. The computer's sitting in the corner with its arms crossed, looking smug.

**THE MODEL:** it had Middle Tennessee winning 26-24. That's a two-point loss for the Owls, which is still a cover at +2.5, so even the model's "bad" outcome cashes your ticket. It also has Jacksonville State over New Mexico State 30-22; the Gamecocks lead 7-0 early.

**SECOND HALF NEEDS:** Kennesaw State to lose by 2 or fewer, or just win the thing. Two quarters of no-funny-business. Don't let Middle Tennessee go rumblin', bumblin', stumblin' into a late backdoor touchdown.

reports.title: Monday Night Final(ish): the scoreboard froze at 2:21 of the 4th, Dallas 38, Philly 21. Open the app, Rich!
reports.text:

**MY BETS:** Nothing. Zero bets all day, $0.00 net. Rich is a perfect 0-0. You can't fumble if you never touch the ball. Undefeated, untested, unbothered.

**AI-LOX:** No locks today, 0-0, $0.00. The computer kept its wallet in its pocket, which was the smartest thing it did all night (keep reading).

**THE MODEL:** The only game on the board is Dallas at Philly, frozen with Dallas up 38-21. The computer called it 24-24, a coin flip with Philly by a tenth of a point. It's not final yet, but here's where it stands:
- Winner: had Philly. Dallas is up 17. Whoop!
- Spread: took Philly +6.5. They're 10.5 points short of covering.
- Total: said Under 56.5 (model 47.5). There are already 59 on the board, so the under is getting rumblin', bumblin', stumblin' run over by 2.5 and counting.

The model is 0-for-3 so far. The computer had this one tied, and the computer should be unplugged. That's why they play the games!

Final grades come when the scoreboard wakes up. Good night, and keep your powder dry, Rich.

reports.title: Afternoon catch-up: the early AND late windows, all in one, because the computer forgot to ring the doorbell!
reports.text:

Now the Carolina Experience. Rich took **Panthers -2.5** in a 3-leg parlay *and* the **Bucs-Panthers under**. Tampa Bay hung **43** on them, 43-13. The under lost by 10.5, the parlay died on that leg, and the Jets leg didn't make it either. Rumblin', bumblin', stumblin'... right off a cliff. Betting both sides of the Panthers is like buying two tickets on the Titanic.

**The 4-leg overs combo is ALIVE, 3 for 3:**

- Browns-Titans 51 (needed 37)
- 49ers-Falcons **49 (needed 48.5)**. By half a point! That's why they play the games!
